steps.code:
# Get genre for each common song
from collections import Counter
genre_counts = Counter()
for song_id in common_song_ids:
    song_info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    genre = song_info['genre']
    genre_counts[genre] += 1
    print(f"Song {song_id}: {song_info['title']} - {genre}")

print("\nGenre counts:", dict(genre_counts))
most_common = genre_counts.most_common(1)[0]
print(f"Most liked genre in playlists: {most_common[0]} with {most_common[1]} songs")
